result.reason: The added language reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site deliverables, Content, and customer/user data; HDI expressly assigns its rights; HDI retains its pre-existing platform, tools, and know-how; and the Company receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI materials. It creates no joint ownership and leaves the existing scope and approval provisions unchanged. Drafting is professional, though “such rights” and “as embedded in the Site” could be slightly more precise.
